description_en:
After a job is created, you can perform the Cancel operation to stop the job while it is running.
After a job reaches the pending confirmation state, you can perform the Abolish operation to stop the job, or perform the Execute operation to continue the job execution
description_zh:
创建作业后，在运行过程中 【取消】操作可以终止作业的运行。
作业在到达等待确认状态后，【放弃】操作可以终止作业的继续运行，【执行】操作则继续完成作业的执行操作
kebab_example: aliyun iacservice operate-job --task-id task-518855d9a058cfffe0e0a92745bbc --job-id job-5fd38c9b92d54fff865d936f22a39 --comment dasd --api-version 2021-08-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: OperateJob

parameters.help_en:
The operation type. Valid values:
execute: continues the Apply operation after the Plan is complete.
abolish: abandons a job that has completed the Plan preview.
cancel: cancels a job that is running or queued
parameters.help_zh:
操作类型
execute：Plan完成后继续执行Apply操作
abolish：放弃已完成 Plan 预览的 Job
cancel：取消正在执行中或排队中的 Job
parameters.name: operation_type

parameters.help_en: The description. The length is 0 to 128 characters
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en:
The task type. Valid values:

Task: regular task (default).

parameters.help_zh:

Task：常规任务（默认）

SceneTestingTask：场景化测试任务
